pages.text: Exploration is far easier when aided by instruments, maps and  compasses. A piece of advice: it is far cheaper to buy maps from villagers than to make your own.

pages.title: Atlas
pages.text: Stiching maps together and storing them in a book is far more convienent than carrying several map scrolls with you.

pages.title: Nature's Compass
pages.text: Can be tuned to point to a specific biome

pages.title: Explorer's Compass
pages.text: Can be tuned to point to a specific structure, the structure has to existed for a suficient time and will not work on things built by you as they are too recent
